title: Director, Power Operations (on-site Shackelford County, TX)
description:

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) powers Oracle’s global cloud services through highly available, large\-scale, enterprise\-grade data center environments. The Data Center Infrastructure Operations / Facilities team plays a critical role in sustaining OCI’s performance, security, and operational resilience by ensuring infrastructure systems operate reliably at scale. You will join a technically rigorous organization with a culture grounded in operational excellence, disciplined processes, and continuous improvement, where infrastructure reliability, safety, and execution quality are foundational to delivering cloud services worldwide.  

**Role Overview**The **Director of Power Operations** is responsible for leading the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of power generation and delivery assets supporting OCI’s energy resilience strategy. This role provides operational leadership across power plants, ensuring high availability, regulatory compliance, and optimized lifecycle performance of generation assets.

The role also supports fuel procurement strategy, power purchase agreements (PPAs), and coordination with power providers/stakeholders and regulators to ensure long\-term operational stability.
  
**Key Responsibilities**

description:

We are looking for a highly capable Quality Technical Program Manager to serve our Data Center Manufacturing site. This role is responsible for leading the quality aspects of new programs from inception through launch and into sustained production. title: Production Engineering Associate Manager, Body in White, Data Center Manufacturing
description:

title: Turbomachinery Construction Manager
description:
Pacifico Energy is a global energy infrastructure firm supporting complex, large load projects from development through to operations. The company serves as a trusted partner across engineering, financing, construction, and optimization, delivering tailored power solutions for large energy users, including data centers. With a proven international track record and over 15 years as a large\-scale developer, Pacifico brings speed and knowledgeable oversight to projects from start to finish.

  

Cedar Creek is a 1,100 MW simple\-cycle gas turbine power project moving toward commercial operation. As Commissioning Manager you lead the owner's commissioning organization through startup and performance testing of the full turbine fleet. It is the seat that decides when the project is finished.

 **What you get to do:**

* Oversee gas turbine and generator delivery, storage and preservation.
* Monitor machine setting and alignment against vendor tolerances.
* Oversee installation of turbine auxiliaries, lube oil and inlet air systems.
* Monitor lube oil flushing and cleanliness through to acceptance.
* Coordinate OEM field service representatives across the fleet.
* Review work packages early — a packaging flaw repeats on every unit.

**What you bring to the role:**

* 12\+ years installing large gas turbines and generators, at least 5 supervising.
* 5\+ years representing an owner over an EPC contractor under a lump\-sum contract.
* Deep familiarity with OEM installation procedures and alignment practice.
* Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, or equivalent field experience.

**Nice to have:**

* Multi\-unit fleet installation experience.
* Proficiency with Bluebeam Revu, Procore and AI tools used with human verification.

title: Electrical Construction Manager
description:
Pacifico Energy is a global energy infrastructure firm supporting complex, large load projects from development through to operations. The company serves as a trusted partner across engineering, financing, construction, and optimization, delivering tailored power solutions for large energy users, including data centers. With a proven international track record and over 15 years as a large\-scale developer, Pacifico brings speed and knowledgeable oversight to projects from start to finish.

  

Cedar Creek is a 1,100 MW simple\-cycle gas turbine power project built under a lump\-sum EPC contract. As Electrical Construction Manager you represent the owner for electrical installation plant\-wide — work that is largely buried or energized by the time anyone thinks to question it.

 **What you get to do:**

* Oversee installation of generator connections, switchgear, transformers and busduct.
* Monitor cable installation, terminations and grounding across the plant.
* Oversee lighting, small power and electrical balance of plant.
* Track electrical interfaces at the project boundary.
* Review construction work packages and flag scope or constraint gaps early.
* Attend system walkdowns and identify punch list items.
* Monitor preservation and storage of electrical equipment through to installation.

 **What you bring to the role:**

* 12\+ years in electrical construction on power plants, at least 5 supervising.
* 5\+ years representing an owner over an EPC contractor under a lump\-sum contract.
* Hands\-on experience with generator connections and medium voltage systems.
* Working knowledge of NFPA 70 and NFPA 70E.
* Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, or equivalent field experience.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with generator step\-up and auxiliary transformer installation.
* Proficiency with Bluebeam Revu, Procore and AI tools used with human verification.

title: Project Engineer Senior/Principal
description:

10\-10\-2026

**Job Summary**

Responsible to the assigned supervisor for performing complex engineering work activities and projects requiring the application of engineering knowledge in a safe, effective, efficient and economic accomplishment of assigned objectives.**Job Description**

**Multiple positions available**

**Note:** *This position is posted in a range. The final grade and compensation offered will be based on the successful candidate's education, experience, and relevant skills.*

**Overview:** The **Project Engineer** serves as the **AEP Engineering Lead** for complex, multi‑disciplinary **Generation Projects**, spanning the full project lifecycle with a primary focus on **conceptual and detailed design**, **procurement**, and technical support during **construction and commissioning**. This role provides technical leadership and coordination across internal engineering teams, external consultants, OEMs, EPC contractors, and project stakeholders to ensure safe, reliable, cost‑effective delivery of utility‑scale power generation assets.


The portfolio includes both **new‑build** and **major retrofit** initiatives, such as:

* **Simple Cycle Gas Turbine Plants**
* **Combined Cycle Gas Turbine (CCGT) Plants**
* **Utility‑Scale Solar Facilities**
* **Wind Generation Projects**
* **Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)**
* **Environmental Retrofit and fuel Conversion Projects** for existing thermal plants

***Key Responsibilities:***

* Develop and manage Engineering Work Plan.
* Lead the Engineering Design Review process and respond to Requests for Information (RFIs).
* Coordinate design efforts with internal AEP teams (Engineering, Operations, IT/Technology) and external partners (Developers, Architects/Engineers, Original Equipment Manufacturers, regulatory agencies).
* Provide support during construction and Facilitate project closeout activities

title: Lead Project Manager, Business Management.
description:
**Lead Project Manager – Business Management**

**Overview**

The Oracle Health Federal Consulting team is seeking a Lead Project Manager to lead business management operations and continuous process improvement across the organization. This senior role establishes clear operating rhythms, strengthens process ownership, and helps teams execute consistently as priorities, staffing needs, and delivery demands change.


You will turn complex operational information into practical workflows, decision materials, and action plans. The role partners closely with delivery, finance, and leadership teams to improve how work moves from intake through planning, staffing, execution, and follow\-through.


**What You'll Do**

• Lead the design, execution, and continuous improvement of core business management processes across the organization


• Establish and maintain process flows, standard operating procedures, and handoff expectations for staffing, hiring, delivery readiness, and resource planning


• Run the recurring business management cadence, including team meetings, workstream reviews, action tracking, and management of risks and dependencies


• Partner with leaders to clarify workstream ownership, decision rights, coverage needs, and changes to roles or reporting structures


• Improve shared documentation, collaboration channels, and business management tools to reduce friction and make information easier to find and use


• Use operational data to monitor demand, staffing coverage, delivery capacity, and workflow trends, then recommend practical improvements


• Support financial planning, forecasting, and variance reviews by connecting business activities, resource plans, and delivery demand


• Build strategy and continuously improvement to dashboards, metrics, and executive reporting that surface progress, risks, and opportunities early


**What You'll Bring (Basic Qualifications)**

• 8–10 years of experience in project or program management, business operations

title: Project Engineer, New Product Introduction, Nexus
description:
**What to Expect**
The Project Engineer at the Tesla Megafactory is a key technical member to drive collaboration at multiple levels with various cross\-functional teams to deliver and execute product change management to the factory. The Project Engineer is responsible for supporting the development of new processes and carrying out each trial exactly to the established product specification. This includes managing the program from early prototype builds through to the launch of the production line. This role also extends into ongoing improvements to product to support effective scale and sustaining of Tesla Energy products. The primary role of the Project Engineer will be to test and validate systems and parts involved in product development and manufacturing to ensure products are of the highest quality. The Project Engineer will also establish validation standards, develop testing protocols, prepare equipment, document test results, and maintain records. The Project Engineer will identify, report, and adjust equipment or processes that require improvement. The Project Engineer will collaborate with safety, design, product excellence, change control, manufacturing, and service departments.  

**What You'll Do*** Lead manufacturing line trials for new products and processes to ensure product specifications and standards are achieved
* Manage quality assurance and procedures by testing and validating systems and parts; scope and implement new validation standards, and procedures
* Conduct Trial Preparation: Ensure part availability, line readiness, and pre\-requisite data obtained and consolidated; Complete Trial Report: Document observations, analysis, and results, make recommendations as needed and drive solutions
* Record all issues found during trials and help drive to closure; Manage Trial Recovery: Ensure manufacturing lines are validated and/or restored to prior condition post\-trial(s). Evaluate the success of each trial (yield, downtime, cost, safety, etc.

title: Director, Project Development
description: About Commonwealth Fusion Systems: Commonwealth Fusion Systems is on a mission to deliver the urgent transition to fusion energy. Combining decades of research, top talent, and new technologies, we’re designing and building commercially viable fusion power plants. And we're working with policymakers, suppliers, and many others to build the energy industry of the future. We’re in the best position to make it happen. Since 2018, we’ve raised $4 billion of capital, making us the largest and leading fusion company in the world. Now we’re looking for more thinkers, doers, builders, and makers to join us. People who’ll bring new perspectives, solve tough problems, and thrive as part of a team. If that’s you and this role fits, we want to hear from you. Join the power movement as Director, Project Development We are a historic moment, with CFS on the cusp of proving the commercial viability of fusion power via our SPARC demonstration plant in Devens, MA. This role will play an instrumental part in taking the next step after this proof point by developing and delivering the first grid scale commercial fusion power plant. We are looking for an exceptional candidate, with the experience, tenacity, and drive to not only develop the site for the first ARC power plant near Richmond, VA, but establish the pipeline and the playbook to deliver the first set of ARC power plants. This is a unique opportunity to participate in the delivery of power plants that will mark a new era of commercial fusion power. The focus of this position is to develop and implement strategic plans to deliver the world’s first set of Fusion Power Plants to the grid by the early 2030s. The Director, Project Development is responsible for managing all aspects of the project schedule which include securing all permits and approvals required to begin construction on schedule and within budget.
